name: Privatzimmer-Ferienwohnung Messner Klaus
beschreibung:
Overview

The Gästehaus Messner Klaus is located at Hinterthiersee 115 in the municipality of Thiersee in the Tyrolean district of Kufstein, in the heart of the Kufsteinerland holiday region. According to the accommodation directory of the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser – Brixental, the house is run both as a holiday flat or apartment and as private rooms. It stands amid green meadows in a very quiet, sunny location with no traffic noise, only about five minutes' walk from the centre of Hinterthiersee. Guest rooms with shower, WC and balcony as well as one apartment are available. Among the options offered are a double room with shower, WC and balcony (15 m², one to two people), a double room with conservatory (15 m²), a triple room with balcony (15 m², one to three people) and a 70 m² apartment with two bedrooms for two to four people.

History/Background

The sources consulted provide no information on the origins and history of the house; reliable historical details can therefore not be substantiated. What is certain is that it is a privately run guesthouse in the hamlet of Hinterthiersee. The surroundings are rural in character and lie in the Kufsteinerland near the Austrian-Bavarian border. The village of Thiersee with the Passionsspielhaus is about five kilometres away, and according to SkiWelt information the distance to the centre of Kufstein is about 13 kilometres.

Getting there

The property describes arrival by car as follows: coming from Kufstein, it is about seven kilometres to Thiersee and a further five kilometres to Hinterthiersee; after the Hotel Thaler turn left, pass the Haus Renate, keep right and reach the guesthouse after about 100 metres. Coming from Bayrischzell-Landl, the route leads about two kilometres towards Thiersee, then turn right towards Hinterthiersee; before the Hotel Thaler turn right, pass the Haus Renate, keep right and after about 100 metres you reach the guesthouse. This route description comes from the source mentioned and should be checked directly with the property before travelling. According to the included services, parking spaces are available. The nearest railway station is in Kufstein, about 12 kilometres away.

Tips

According to the accommodation directory, bed linen, towels and the parking space are included in the services. Breakfast is served; the accepted payment methods listed are euros, cash and invoice, and a children's discount is also mentioned. According to the description, a cross-country ski trail and ski lifts are located close by; the Haltjochlift (Tirolina) in Hinterthiersee is right by the house, and the Schneeberg-Hagerlifte in Vorderthiersee about three kilometres away. As not all details are publicly available, it is advisable to enquire about availability and current terms directly with the property.

Best time to travel

The sources do not give a general recommendation for the best time to travel. Because of its location in the Thierseer Tal with hiking and mountain options in summer and a cross-country ski trail and ski lifts nearby, the house can generally be used in both main seasons. For specific season and opening times, you should contact the property directly.
